touch_semantics.first_tap: Selects the actual transformed/hit-tested item and arms its exact typed identity/context; default hover/focus is not sufficient to open.
touch_semantics.second_tap: Original ACTION_SELECT_ITEM only for same selected title identity/context and established elapsed interval.
touch_semantics.outside_interval: Arms a fresh first tap without opening; this is inherited existing timing, not an unconditional any-time second-tap promise.
touch_semantics.hold: Clears tap arm, copies exact selected CFileItem into common popup, suppresses release tap for600ms.
touch_semantics.selection_key: Length-framed media type, original path, source directory/BrowsePath, saved capsule, Search provider, namespaced IDs, season and episode; never row coordinates or pointer as owned identity.
touch_semantics.dismissal: No mutation/rebind/Container.Refresh on cancel; real device focus/scroll retention still requires Android/Fold execution.
touch_semantics.scope: One-finger touch only in verified Infinity-owned surfaces; original mouse/D-pad/native provider paths remain preserved.
